protocol.limit: Fixed mean selected earlier on train CV; these are post-selection training diagnostics, not unbiased final evidence. Independent prospective calibration/test determines final reported coverage.
protocol.outer_fit_calibration_split: Of each36 (or region equivalent), reserve one third for independent calibration; remaining two thirds fit mean/scale.
protocol.residual_scale: Three-fold OOF predictions on mean-fitting geometries only; calibration and outer-validation labels excluded.
protocol.selection: Joint90% proper field interval score improves at least5%, frequency proper score degrades no more than5%, joint empirical coverage loses no more than one geometry; otherwise raw retained.
